description: The ore is heavy and dull, still embedded in the chunk of stone it was pried from. It has a rough, uneven surface and looks like it was pulled out with force. There are small, jagged edges where the metal meets the rock, and a faint, dark color. It feels cold and solid, not polished or finished.
status_note: Approved at Roc's gate 2026-08-13. Forage-sourced probe-side (phaser/src/world/collectExtraForage.ts, Collection & Discovery mode) — not yet an authored screen-specs.json pool.
role_link_note: The raw ore that feeds the Blacksmith's centerpiece work — distinct from key_arch_filing, a filing off the already-forged piece back in town.
